name: workable_subdomain_example
spec_quote: A host matches a suffix when it equals the suffix or ends with "." + suffix (so `notworkable.com` is NOT workable).

name: exact_host_equals_suffix
spec_quote: A host matches a suffix when it equals the suffix or ends with "." + suffix

name: notworkable_is_not_workable
spec_quote: A host matches a suffix when it equals the suffix or ends with "." + suffix (so `notworkable.com` is NOT workable).

name: uppercase_host_with_port_and_query
spec_quote: The platform is decided by the URL's host only (lower-cased; scheme, port, path, query and fragment ignored).

name: platform_only_in_query_is_null
spec_quote: `https://www.google.com/?q=workable.com` → null (the platform name appears only in the query).

name: empty_url_is_null
spec_quote: Empty, missing or unparseable URL → null.

name: null_url_is_null
spec_quote: Empty, missing or unparseable URL → null.

name: jazzhr_applytojob
spec_quote: `https://acme.applytojob.com/apply/xyz` → jazzhr

name: successfactors_sapsf_suffix
spec_quote: successfactors | `successfactors.com`, `successfactors.eu`, `sapsf.com`

name: suffix_in_middle_of_host_is_null
spec_quote: A host matches a suffix when it equals the suffix or ends with "." + suffix

name: platform_in_path_is_null
spec_quote: The platform is decided by the URL's host only (scheme, port, path, query and fragment ignored).

name: workday_myworkdayjobs_subdomain
spec_quote: workday | `myworkdayjobs.com`, `myworkdaysite.com`

name: row_ats_empty_falls_back_to_url
spec_quote: So a row whose `ats_url` is empty and `url` is a Workable link → workable

name: row_ats_rippling_wins_over_linkedin_url
spec_quote: a row whose `ats_url` is a Rippling link and `url` is a LinkedIn link → rippling

name: row_ats_unmatched_falls_back_to_lever_url
spec_quote: a row whose `ats_url` is a LinkedIn link (matches nothing) and `url` is a Lever link → lever

name: row_missing_keys_is_null
spec_quote: `platform_of(row["ats_url"])` when that is not null; otherwise `platform_of(row["url"])`. Missing keys count as empty.

name: summarize_basic_counts
spec_quote: `rows`: number of rows. `ok`: rows with `elig` == "可投". `ok_ab`: 可投 rows whose `tier` is "A" or "B". `ok_intern`: 可投 rows whose `level` is "Internship".

name: summarize_skips_null_platforms_and_absent_platforms
spec_quote: Only rows whose row_platform is not null are counted. ... A platform with no rows does not appear.

name: summarize_ab_any_blocked_with_orig_a_or_b
spec_quote: `ab_any`: rows (any elig) whose `tier` is "A" or "B", or whose `tier` is "Blocked" and `tier_orig` is "A" or "B".

name: summarize_missing_fields_and_newgrad_levels
spec_quote: Missing fields count as empty strings. ... `ok_newgrad`: 可投 rows whose `level` is anything else that is non-empty ("New grad", "Early career", …).
